title: Make the meme (post-Yes reveal) page cuter

requirements.text: Update the post-"Yes" celebratory reveal section (the state rendered when `answered === true` in `frontend/src/App.tsx`) to look noticeably more cute/soft while keeping the existing meme image, heading, and romantic message content.

quotes: change the meme page make it more cute

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking “Yes! 💕”, the reveal view has a clearly cuter/softer presentation than the current centered layout (e.g., pastel card/container treatment, softer shadows, rounded elements, cute decorative accents), without changing the flow of the app.
The meme image `/assets/generated/valentine-meme.dim_1200x900.png` is still displayed and remains the primary visual element.
The heading text “Good choice ❤️” remains exactly the same.
The romantic message paragraph remains exactly the same text as currently shown in the reveal view.

requirements.text: Add cute decorative visuals to the reveal page using new static image assets in `frontend/public/assets/generated` (e.g., kawaii heart/sparkle stickers and/or a subtle repeating background pattern), and render them in the reveal layout without fetching them from the backend.

quotes: change the meme page make it more cute

acceptanceCriteria: The new decorative assets are present under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and are referenced directly by the frontend via `/assets/generated/...` paths.
Decorations enhance the reveal view while not obscuring the meme image, heading, or message on common screen sizes (mobile through desktop).

requirements.text: Enhance the reveal page motion to feel softer/cuter (e.g., gentle float/bob or sparkle-like subtle animation on decorative elements) while preserving the existing fade/scale-in feel and avoiding distracting motion.

quotes: change the meme page make it more cute

acceptanceCriteria: Reveal page includes at least one additional subtle, cute animation (beyond the existing fade/scale) that runs smoothly and does not cause layout shift.
Animations respect usability (no rapid flashing; overall motion remains gentle).

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI components must be composed, not modified).
Do not change backend code; this request is purely a frontend visual/style update.
Do not change the reveal page user-facing text content (keep “Good choice ❤️” and the existing romantic message exactly as-is).
nonGoals: Do not add new screens, routing, or additional app features beyond styling the existing reveal/meme page.
Do not replace or modify the existing meme image file unless explicitly requested later.

required: Kawaii heart-and-sparkle sticker cluster with transparent background (cute-stickers-1.dim_512x512.png)
Soft pastel repeating background pattern with tiny hearts/sparkles (cute-pattern-bg.dim_1600x900.png)
